summary: I pass on everything in this game. The Dodgers are the favorite at -190 at the best price, and that looks about right: Blake Snell has a 1.8984 ERA and a 1.8564 FIP over his starts, and LAD has the better run differential per game (1.163 against ATL's 0.804) and has won 8 of its last 10. But the books already price all of that, and the best LAD quote of -190 sits close to the books' de-vigged 0.6442. On the other side, Ray Kerr has a thin sample with no usable ERA, so ATL at +180 is a price on an unknown, not a read. The run line and the 7.5 total are both priced near a coin flip, and nothing in what we have separates the sides. The lineups are not posted, matchup history is missing, and every player prop quote is hours old with only a few books behind it, so I leave the props alone too. A posted lineup and fresh prop prices would be the first things to change this.

reasons.claim: Blake Snell has a strong ERA and FIP over his starts and LAD has the better run differential, but those facts are public and the books' de-vigged number for LAD already reflects them.
The best LAD quote is close to the books' own fair number, so the price leaves little room, and ATL's starter is a thin sample with no usable ERA, so there is no case for the other side either.

calls.what_would_change_it: A posted lineup showing key LAD bats resting, or a move in the LAD price toward -178, would make me look again.

reasons.claim: The books' fair number for ATL +1.5 is close to my own read, and the data gives nothing about the margin of the game beyond the price itself.
Matchup depth and lineups are missing, so I cannot say how ATL's lineup sets up against Snell or how a close loss versus a blowout is likely to look.

calls.what_would_change_it: A posted ATL lineup that looks strong against Snell, or an ATL +1.5 price at -117 or better, would bring this into play.

reasons.claim: The total is priced almost evenly, and the data points both ways: Snell's numbers suggest fewer runs while ATL's starter has no usable record to weigh against them.
Lineups are missing and the forecast shows light wind, so there is no clear environmental push either way.

calls.what_would_change_it: A posted lineup with several regulars out, or a bullpen report that changes who is available, could move the total, and an Over price at -104 or better would interest me.
